name: Deterministic Build, Cook & Patch Pipeline
actions: inspect visual output, measures, lineage, and boundaries
seal an independently verified evidence receipt
explicitly export a reviewed candidate receipt
summary: Cook reviewed source into digest-bound chunks and reproducible packages with cancellation cleanup, atomic patches, and rollback.
notes: This is an AXM-native foundation route. It uses no external runtime dependency, writes nothing automatically, and cannot promote candidates into the permanent library.
